lines.en: label beachvacation8:
Roughly 30 minutes later...
lines.zh: 大约三十分钟后……

lines.en: scene beachdnd1
: Finally! The time has come!
lines.zh: : 终于！这一刻到来了！

lines.en: : For what seemed like millennia, I have awaited this moment.
lines.zh: : 仿佛过了千年，我一直在等待这个瞬间。

lines.en: : Through all of the pain I have endured...all of the harsh rays of the sun! I have finally returned to my element!
lines.zh: : 熬过了所有的痛苦……还有那毒辣的阳光！我终于回到了属于我的元素！

lines.en: scene beachdnd2
: You were outside for like half a day. Why are you being so dramatic about this?
lines.zh: : 你也就在外面待了半天而已。至于这么夸张吗？

lines.en: : Maybe she’s just...really excited?
lines.zh: : 也许她只是……真的很兴奋？

lines.en: : I mean, duhh, but like, this isn’t even the first time we’ve played. We’re just starting a new campaign and Molly’s treating it like the biggest moment in her life.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，废话，可是这又不是我们第一次玩。我们只是要开个新战役，Molly搞得像是她人生中最重大的时刻似的。

lines.en: : Ha ha ha! That is where you are mistaken, Nithhala!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈！这你可就错了，尼萨拉！

lines.en: : You can call me Rin while we’re not playing, you know. That’s my actual name. Not sure if you realize that or not.
lines.zh: : 我们没在玩的时候你可以叫我Rin啊。那才是我的真名。不知道你有没有意识到这一点。

lines.en: : Silence, Nithhala!
lines.zh: : 闭嘴，尼萨拉！

lines.en: scene beachdnd3
: Today is the biggest moment of my life, for I have finally found a place to call my own!
lines.zh: : 今天是我人生中最重大的时刻，因为我终于找到了属于自己的归宿！

lines.en: : And I know what you may be thinking...
lines.zh: : 我知道你们可能会想……

lines.en: : “Molly! What about the manga club? What about all of the wonderful times we have shared in that small, enclosed space?!”
lines.zh: : 「Molly！那漫画社怎么办？我们在那个狭小封闭的空间里共度的美好时光又算什么？！」

lines.en: : And you would be right in asking that...but this is different! This is vacation!
lines.zh: : 你们这么问也没错……但这次不一样！这是度假！

lines.en: : The chance to enjoy our youth!
lines.zh: : 是享受青春的机会！

lines.en: : I’ve finally found a class who accepts me for who I am! So who would I be to treat this like just another day?!
lines.zh: : 我终于找到了一个接纳真实的我的班级！我怎么能把它当成普通的一天来对待？！

lines.en: scene beachdnd4
: So inspirational. I can feel myself shivering in anticipation.
lines.zh: : 真感人。我能感觉到自己正因期待而颤抖。

lines.en: : Do you want my hoodie, Maya? It might help with the whole shivering thing.
lines.zh: : Maya，要不要我的连帽衫？说不定能缓解你颤抖的问题。

lines.en: scene beachdnd5
: You’re just looking for an excuse to take your shirt off in front of Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你只是在找借口在Sensei面前脱衣服吧。

lines.en: : I’m just trying to help out a friend in need! It’s totally different.
lines.zh: : 我只是想帮一帮有需要的朋友！完全不一样好吗。

lines.en: scene beachdnd6
: Oh. Speaking of friends, has anyone seen Futaba anywhere? Wasn't she supposed to be joining us?
lines.zh: : 哦。说到朋友，有人看到二叶去哪儿了吗？她不是说要加入我们吗？

lines.en: : I printed out her character sheet and everything.
lines.zh: : 我还把她的角色卡都打印出来了。

lines.en: : Oh she texted me. She’s not feeling well right now so she’s resting in the bedroom and can’t play tonight.
lines.zh: : 哦，她给我发短信了。她现在不太舒服，在卧室里休息，今晚玩不了。

lines.en: : Wait, really? But it’s the start of the campaign. That’s a pretty big thing to miss.
lines.zh: : 等等，真的吗？可这是战役的开篇。错过这个可是挺大的事。

lines.en: scene beachdnd7
: You and me can figure out a way to write her in later on. Let’s just focus on getting this thing started so we’re not up until like 3 AM.
lines.zh: : 你和我之后可以想办法把她写进去。我们先专心把这事开个头，免得搞到凌晨三点。

lines.en: : We’re already still running on zero sleep, need I remind you.
lines.zh: : 需要我提醒你吗，我们现在还是零睡眠状态。

lines.en: : Right, right. Well then! Let me just check my notes again and we’ll start in a second.
lines.zh: : 对，对。那么好吧！我再看看笔记，一会儿就开始。

lines.en: scene beachdnd8
: So much energy. So much passion.
lines.zh: : 好有活力。好有热情。

lines.en: : Dungeons and Dragons, which are fictional creatures in case you were wondering, is a truly wonderful game.
lines.zh: : 龙与地下城——顺便说一句，龙和地下城都是虚构生物——真是个美妙的游戏。

lines.en: : They haven’t even started playing yet.
lines.zh: : 她们都还没开始玩呢。

lines.en: : I finally know what it means to be young.
lines.zh: : 我终于明白什么是年轻了。

lines.en: Molly begins to flip through a few papers behind her weird folder-thing while Tsuneyo and I sit off on the side, trying to figure out what’s going on.
lines.zh: Molly开始在她那个古怪的文件夹板后面翻几张纸，我和Tsuneyo坐在旁边，试图搞清楚状况。

lines.en: Apparently, Tsuneyo still needs to get a better grip on the basics before she’s allowed to play, so she’s being forced to watch this time.
lines.zh: 据说Tsuneyo还得先好好掌握基础才能上场，所以这次只能被迫观战。

lines.en: Just how complicated can this sort of game be? It seems like there is an annoying amount of prep work involved.
lines.zh: 这种游戏到底能有多复杂？感觉准备工作多得烦人。

lines.en: Good for Molly for being able to keep all of this organized, I guess...
lines.zh: 不过Molly能把这一切整理得井井有条，也算她厉害吧……

lines.en: scene beachdnd9
: Did you ever figure out what class you’re going to play? I remember you having a hard time last I checked.
lines.zh: : 你决定好要玩什么职业了吗？我记得上次问你的时候你还很纠结。

lines.en: : I’m playing a cleric this time.
lines.zh: : 这次我玩牧师。

lines.en: scene beachdnd10
: A cleric? Why a cleric?
lines.zh: : 牧师？为什么是牧师？

lines.en: : It’s just more suited to my strengths, I guess.
lines.zh: : 大概只是更契合我的长处吧。

lines.en: : What about you? Wizard again?
lines.zh: : 你呢？又是法师？

lines.en: scene beachdnd11
: What do you mean again?! I’ve only played a wizard one other time!
lines.zh: : 什么叫「又是」？！我就玩过一次法师而已！

lines.en: : We’ve only played one other time.
lines.zh: : 我们也就玩过一次而已。

lines.en: scene beachdnd12
: What are you going to play, Sana? It’s your first time, right?
lines.zh: : Sana你要玩什么？你是第一次玩吧？

lines.en: : Umm...Y-Yeah.
lines.zh: : 嗯……是……是的。

lines.en: : I’ve watched a few videos of other people playing so I get how it works, but it’s still kind of nerve-wracking actually playing for the first time...
lines.zh: : 我看过一些别人玩的视频，所以懂规则，不过真要自己上场还是有点紧张……

lines.en: scene beachdnd13
: I’m going to play an...umm...
lines.zh: : 我要玩一个……嗯……

lines.en: : I'm going to play an orc barbarian.
lines.zh: : 我要玩一个兽人蛮战士。

lines.en: : Neat.
lines.zh: : 挺好。

lines.en: : That’s...
lines.zh: : 那是……

lines.en: : Yeah, okay.
lines.zh: : 嗯，好吧。

lines.en: scene beachdnd12
: What about you?
lines.zh: : 那你呢？

lines.en: scene beachdnd14
: I’m going to be a rogue. I’ve gotten pretty good at being sneaky lately, so I figure something like this might work out in my favor.
lines.zh: : 我要当游荡者。我最近在「偷偷摸摸」这方面长进不少，所以觉得这个职业应该合我意。

lines.en: : Sneaky?...What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 偷偷摸摸？……什么意思？

lines.en: : I’ll tell you when you’re older, Sana.
lines.zh: : 等你再长大点我就告诉你，Sana。

lines.en: : You’re only a little older than me, though...
lines.zh: : 可你也只比我大一点点啊……

lines.en: scene beachdnd15
: You good over there, Molly? Need my help with anything?
lines.zh: : Molly，你那边还好吗？需要我帮忙吗？

lines.en: : I know you’re not great with numbers and all that jazz.
lines.zh: : 我知道你不太擅长数字之类的东西。

lines.en: : Silence! We will now begin!
lines.zh: : 肃静！现在开始！

lines.en: : Friends of the manga club! Ayane and Sana! Feast your eyes upon me as I narrate the beginning of your adventure!
lines.zh: : 漫画社的朋友们！Ayane和Sana！睁大眼睛看好了，我要为你们讲述冒险的开端！

lines.en: scene beachdnd16
: A thick fog crawls over the mountains and spreads through the forest, obscuring your vision as you slowly open your eyes.
lines.zh: : 浓雾爬过山岭，在森林里弥漫开来，模糊了你们的视线，你们缓缓睁开眼睛。

lines.en: : A shrill scream from a creature you’ve never heard before rings out in the distance.
lines.zh: : 远处传来一声你们从未听过的生物的尖啸。

lines.en: : As you struggle to regain your consciousness, you quickly realize that you’re surrounded by several people you’ve never seen before, in a land equally as unrecognizable.
lines.zh: : 就在你们挣扎着恢复意识的时候，你们很快发现自己被几个素不相识的人包围着，身处一片同样陌生的土地。

lines.en: : The fog begins to lift as soon as the creature’s screams stop, leaving the six...Err, right. No Futaba.
lines.zh: : 那生物的尖叫一停，雾便开始散去，只剩下六……啊，对。没有二叶。

lines.en: : Leaving the five of you alone and confused.
lines.zh: : 只剩下你们五个人，茫然无措。

lines.en: Molly leans back on her cushion and waits for one of the other girls to say something.
lines.zh: Molly往后靠在坐垫上，等着其他女生开口。

lines.en: And, in other news, I’m already lost.
lines.zh: 另外，插播一条：我已经完全看不懂了。

lines.en: scene beachdnd8
: Imagine waking up in a world where you know absolutely no one.
lines.zh: : 想象一下，在一个谁都不认识的世界里醒来。

lines.en: : How horrible that must be.
lines.zh: : 那该有多可怕。

lines.en: : ...Right.
: I wonder if they’ll make it out alive?
lines.zh: : 不知道她们能不能活着出去？

lines.en: : Let’s hope so.
lines.zh: : 但愿如此吧。

lines.en: scene beachdnd17
: You said we’re in the forest, right?
lines.zh: : 你说我们在森林里，对吧？

lines.en: : That’s right.
lines.zh: : 没错。

lines.en: : How far into it can we see?
lines.zh: : 我们能看多远？

lines.en: : Go ahead and roll for perception.
lines.zh: : 来，投个察觉检定。

lines.en: scene beachdnd18
: That’s...a five.
lines.zh: : 那是……五点。

lines.en: : You see trees. That’s it.
lines.zh: : 你们看到树。就这样。

lines.en: : Wow I can feel myself getting stronger by the second.
lines.zh: : 哇，我能感觉到自己每秒都在变强。

lines.en: scene beachdnd19
: Lidearel unsheathes a pair of daggers from her belt and lunges toward the halfling also regaining her consciousness.
lines.zh: : 莉迪亚瑞尔从腰带上抽出一对匕首，扑向那个同样在恢复意识的半身人。

lines.en: : I’m not playing a halfling anymore. I’m an aarakocra this time.
lines.zh: : 我现在不是半身人了。这次我是鹰身人。

lines.en: scene beachdnd20
: What? Aren’t those the bird people? You’re playing a bird cleric?
lines.zh: : 啥？不就是那些鸟人吗？你玩的是鸟人牧师？

lines.en: : I am.
lines.zh: : 没错。

lines.en: : Well...whatever. I’m lunging at you anyway.
lines.zh: : 嗯……随便吧。反正我还是要扑过去。

lines.en: m" Uhh...okay?"
scene beachdnd21
: So are you like...attacking her or?...
lines.zh: : 所以你是要……攻击她还是？……

lines.en: : What’s going on?
lines.zh: : 到底怎么回事？

lines.en: scene beachdnd19
: I stop directly in front of her.
lines.zh: : 我直接停在她面前。

lines.en: : You...You have something to do with this, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你……这事和你脱不了干系吧？

lines.en: : You look different from the rest of us..You’re much more...feathery...
lines.zh: : 你看起来和我们其他人不一样……你身上……羽毛更多……

lines.en: : Tell us where we are or I’ll cut your throat and sell your plumes to the nearest fletcher.
lines.zh: : 告诉我们这是哪儿，不然我割开你的喉咙，把你的羽毛卖给最近的箭匠。

lines.en: scene beachdnd22
: I’m just as lost as you. So I suggest you put your daggers down before you do something you regret.
lines.zh: : 我和你们一样迷路了。所以我劝你放下匕首，免得做出让自己后悔的事。

lines.en: scene beachdnd23
: E-Everybody just calm down! I know we might be scared...but there has to be an explanation for this!
lines.zh: : 大……大家冷静点！我知道我们可能很害怕……但这事一定有解释的！

lines.en: : Let's just take a second and talk to each other before we do anything crazy...okay?
lines.zh: : 我们先花点时间互相聊聊，再做疯狂的事……好吗？

lines.en: scene beachdnd24
: Your acting has gotten better.
lines.zh: : 你演技进步了。

lines.en: : Thanks. I’ve been practicing voices in my spare time.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。我私下有在练配音。

lines.en: scene beachdnd25
: And why...why would we do that?
lines.zh: : 那我们为什么要那么做？

lines.en: : There’s only one way to fix situations like this...and it involves draining every last drop of blood from whoever was stupid enough to bring us here...
lines.zh: : 要收拾这种局面只有一个办法……那就是把把我们弄到这儿来的蠢货身上的血一滴不剩地放干……

lines.en: scene beachdnd26
scene beachdnd27
: Before you can respond, another cry rings out and fills the area with fog once more.
lines.zh: : 在你们回应之前，又一声啼哭响起，雾气再次弥漫了整个区域。

lines.en: : But this time, as soon as the fog spreads through the forest and crosses your feet, the shaking of a nearby tree beckons your attention.
lines.zh: : 不过这一次，等雾气漫过森林、拂过你们的脚边，附近一棵树的晃动引起了你们的注意。

lines.en: : What kind of tree is it?
lines.zh: : 那是什么树？

lines.en: scene beachdnd28
: Does...it matter?
lines.zh: : 这……重要吗？

lines.en: : It matters to me.
lines.zh: : 对我来说重要。

lines.en: : Uhh...okay. History check, I guess?
lines.zh: : 呃……好吧。那就历史检定？

lines.en: : Five.
lines.zh: : 五点。

lines.en: : You don’t know what kind of tree it is.
lines.zh: : 你不知道那是什么树。

lines.en: : Ugh.
scene beachdnd29
: Heh...it looks like maybe I was too quick to judge...
lines.zh: : 呵……看来我也太早下判断了……

lines.en: : Maybe the five of us have more in common than we thought?
lines.zh: : 也许我们五个人的共同点比我想的要多？

lines.en: scene beachdnd30
: I’m going to move closer to the shaking tree, keeping my daggers drawn.
lines.zh: : 我要靠近那棵晃动的树，匕首保持出鞘。

lines.en: : You’re a rogue. Why are you charging in before anyone else?
lines.zh: : 你是个游荡者。为什么要抢在所有人前面冲上去？

lines.en: : It fits my character.
lines.zh: : 这符合我的角色设定。

lines.en: : Oh. Okay. Fair enough.
lines.zh: : 哦。好吧。说得也是。

lines.en: scene beachdnd27
: The shaking of the tree turns to more of a quake with each step you take closer to it.
lines.zh: : 你们每靠近一步，树的晃动就愈发剧烈，变成了震动。

lines.en: : A scent exudes from the branches and finds its way into your nostrils. It’s a sort of fungus-like, putrid smell that you can’t help but shudder at.
lines.zh: : 一股气味从枝干间弥漫开来，钻进你们的鼻孔。那是一种类似真菌的腐臭味，让人不禁打了个寒颤。

lines.en: : If only I knew what type of tree it was...
lines.zh: : 我要是知道那是什么树就好了……

lines.en: scene beachdnd31
: Wait! Lidearel! We don’t know what’s in there yet! It could be dangerous!
lines.zh: : 等等！莉迪亚瑞尔！我们还不知道里面有什么！可能很危险！

lines.en: : You don’t know her name yet.
lines.zh: : 你还不知道她的名字呢。

lines.en: scene beachdnd32
: Huh? Didn’t she say it when she was lunging at you?
lines.zh: : 哈？她扑向你的时候不是说了吗？

lines.en: : That was out of character. Your character doesn’t know it yet.
lines.zh: : 那是脱离角色的话。你的角色还不知道。

lines.en: : Oh, crap. You’re right. Sorry.
lines.zh: : 哦，靠。你说得对。抱歉。

lines.en: scene beachdnd33
: That smell...it reminds me of home...
lines.zh: : 那个味道……让我想起了家……

lines.en: : Zagull Throat Spear reaches for the greataxe strapped to his back and pulls it out as he moves toward where umm...where Ayane’s character went.
lines.zh: : 扎古尔·贯喉之矛伸手抽出背后的巨斧，朝呃……朝Ayane的角色去的方向走去。

lines.en: scene beachdnd8
: How exciting.
lines.zh: : 好刺激。

lines.en: : What do you think is in the tree?
lines.zh: : 你觉得树里有什么？

lines.en: : What, the fungus thing? Probably a mushroom monster or something.
lines.zh: : 什么，那个真菌玩意儿？大概是个蘑菇怪之类的吧。

lines.en: : Those don’t exist. You’re an idiot.
lines.zh: : 那种东西不存在。你是个白痴。

lines.en: : Pretty soon, you’re going to be saying stupid things like how dragons exist as well.
lines.zh: : 很快你就要说出龙也存在之类的蠢话了。

lines.en: : Then what do you think is in the tree, Tsuneyo?
lines.zh: : 那你觉得树里有什么，Tsuneyo？

lines.en: : Branches. Leaves. Tree things.
lines.zh: : 树枝。树叶。树的东西。

lines.en: : Maybe even a bird.
lines.zh: : 说不定还有只鸟。

lines.en: : Then why is it shaking?
lines.zh: : 那它为什么会晃？

lines.en: : Wind.
: Are they going to fight wind?
lines.zh: : 她们要和风打架？

lines.en: : They will certainly try.
lines.zh: : 她们肯定会试试。

lines.en: : I can’t imagine it will be easy to hit.
lines.zh: : 我想打中可不简单。

lines.en: : I’m going to go get a drink.
lines.zh: : 我去拿杯喝的。

lines.en: scene beachdnd27
: As Zagull Throat Spear and Lidearel approach the tree, the shaking comes to an abrupt stop and the fog clears once again.
lines.zh: : 就在扎古尔·贯喉之矛和莉迪亚瑞尔靠近那棵树的时候，晃动突然停了，雾气也再次散去。

lines.en: : The forest is now dead quiet apart from the sounds of several chirping insects.
lines.zh: : 除了几声虫鸣，森林里死一般寂静。

lines.en: : But, just as you begin to think you’re safe...the smell grows stronger.
lines.zh: : 可就在你们开始以为自己安全了的时候……那股气味变得更浓了。

lines.en: scene beachdnd34
: Nothing’s popped out of the tree yet, though, right?
lines.zh: : 不过还没有东西从树里蹦出来，对吧？

lines.en: : Right.
: Okay. I’m going to approach the tree as well, but can I perception-check to see if I can spot whatever is inside of it?
lines.zh: : 好。我也要靠近那棵树，不过我能做个察觉检定，看看能不能发现里面有什么吗？

lines.en: : Mhm. Go ahead.
lines.zh: : 嗯。来吧。

lines.en: scene beachdnd35
: This is the one. I can feel it.
lines.zh: : 就是这一把了。我能感觉到。

lines.en: : Good luck...
lines.zh: : 祝你好运……

lines.en: Rin keeps the die in her hand for several seconds, shaking it up and down before-
lines.zh: Rin把骰子攥在手里晃了好几秒，上下摇着，然后——

lines.en: scene beachdnd34
: What is it?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？

lines.en: : A five.
lines.zh: : 五点。

lines.en: : You don’t see anything in the tree.
lines.zh: : 你没在树里看到任何东西。

lines.en: scene beachdnd36
: Ngh!
lines.zh: : 嗯啊啊啊！

lines.en: scene beachdnd27
: As Nithhala fails yet another tree-related roll, the branches shake one final time and out hop two creatures, one directly in front of Zagull and one in front of Lidearel.
lines.zh: : 就在尼萨拉又一次掷骰失败的时候，树枝最后晃动了一下，跳出两只生物，一只正落在扎古尔面前，一只落在莉迪亚瑞尔面前。

lines.en: scene beachdnd37
: Do we know what kind of monsters they are from our old world or anything?
lines.zh: : 从我们原来的世界里，我们认得出这是什么怪物吗？

lines.en: : I don’t know if you read my backstory but I used to live in the forest when I was a girl, so it would make sense for me to know it.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你有没有看我的背景故事，我小时候住在森林里，所以我会认得也说得通。

lines.en: : Yeah, you can go ahead and roll for history.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你投个历史检定吧。

lines.en: scene beachdnd38
: Sweet...
lines.zh: : 好耶……

lines.en: Ayane picks up a strangely shaped blue die and tosses it onto the table.
lines.zh: Ayane拿起一颗形状奇特的蓝色骰子，扔到了桌上。

lines.en: scene beachdnd39
: That’s a 17.
lines.zh: : 十七点。

lines.en: scene beachdnd40
: Thanks to years of struggling to grow up and foraging for food in the wilderness, you’re able to tell that the monsters in front of you are actually Violet Fungus.
lines.zh: : 多亏了多年来在野外挣扎求生、采集食物的经历，你能认出面前的怪物其实是紫蕈。

lines.en: scene beachdnd41
: In a tree? Why?...
lines.zh: : 在树上？为什么？……

lines.en: : It will make sense eventually.
lines.zh: : 以后会说得通的。

lines.en: : Uhh, okay. If you say so.
lines.zh: : 呃，好吧。你说了算。

lines.en: : Mushrooms? I was just starting to get hungry!
lines.zh: : 蘑菇？我正好开始饿了！

lines.en: scene beachdnd42
: Wait! I recognize those mushrooms! You can’t eat them! They’re poisonous!
lines.zh: : 等等！我认得那些蘑菇！不能吃！有毒！

lines.en: : Step aside, elf. Poisonous is my middle name.
lines.zh: : 让开，精灵。毒就是我的中间名。

lines.en: : You named your character Zagull Poisonous Throat Spear?!
lines.zh: : 你把角色命名为扎古尔·毒·贯喉之矛？！

lines.en: : I SAID MOVE ASIDE!
lines.zh: : 我说了让开！

lines.en: scene beachdnd43
: I told you it was a mushroom monster.
lines.zh: : 我都说了是蘑菇怪吧。

lines.en: : That’s cheating. You know more about the outside world than I do.
lines.zh: : 这是作弊。你对外部世界的了解比我多。

lines.en: : It’s an unfair advantage.
lines.zh: : 这是不公平的优势。

lines.en: scene beachdnd44
: Whatever you say, Tsu-
lines.zh: : 随你怎么说，常——

lines.en: : Is that a beer?
lines.zh: : 那是啤酒吗？

lines.en: : Is it?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: scene beachdnd45
: I just grabbed a can.
lines.zh: : 我只是拿了个罐子。

lines.en: : I don’t think I’m allowed to drink this. My father said it’s bad for me.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我不该喝这个。我父亲说这对身体不好。

lines.en: : You’re allowed to do whatever you want. You’re on vacation.
lines.zh: : 你想做什么都行。你现在在度假。

lines.en: : I suppose you’re right.
lines.zh: : 也许是吧。

lines.en: : Perhaps just a taste will be okay.
lines.zh: : 也许只尝一口没关系。

lines.en: scene beachdnd46
: Sip...
lines.zh: : 吸溜……

lines.en: scene beachdnd45
: Delicious.
lines.zh: : 好喝。

lines.en: scene beachdnd47
: Zzzzzzzzzzzz...
lines.zh: : 呼呼呼呼呼……

lines.en: : I was wondering how that was going to turn out.
lines.zh: : 我还好奇会是什么结果呢。

lines.en: scene beachdnd48
: Did...Tsuneyo just fall asleep on my [uncle]?
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo是刚刚在我[uncle]肩上睡着了吗？

lines.en: : I think she was drinking.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她刚才在喝酒。

lines.en: : I don’t know how I feel about this.
lines.zh: : 我不知道自己对此作何感想。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t worry. She seems harmless enough.
lines.zh: : 我倒不担心。她看起来没什么害处。

lines.en: : I sure hope so.
lines.zh: : 但愿如此吧。

lines.en: scene beachdnd28
: Okay, you were getting ready to attack, weren’t you Sana? That’s what it sounded like but I just want to make sure.
lines.zh: : 好，Sana你正准备攻击，对吧？听起来是这样，不过我想确认一下。

lines.en: : Oh! Um...sorry...Yeah. I wanted to attack it...
lines.zh: : 哦！嗯……抱歉……对。我想攻击它……

lines.en: : Okay. You and Ayane can roll for initiative.
lines.zh: : 好。你和Ayane投先攻。

lines.en: : What about me? I went over to the tree as well.
lines.zh: : 那我呢？我也走到树那边去了啊。

lines.en: : You’re fighting too?
lines.zh: : 你也要打？

lines.en: : Yeah. It’s revenge for all of my failed rolls.
lines.zh: : 对。这是对我所有失败掷骰的复仇。

lines.en: : Then yeah. You three can roll for initiative. Aborea and Urrheak didn’t approach so they’re out for right now.
lines.zh: : 那好。你们三个投先攻。阿波瑞亚和乌尔瑞克没靠近，所以这轮先不算她们。

lines.en: scene beachdnd32
: Wait, what’s going on? I’m having a hard time focusing with Sensei just letting some girl who isn’t me sleep on his shoulder.
lines.zh: : 等等，什么情况？Sensei就这么让一个不是我的女生靠在他肩上睡觉，我没法集中注意力。

lines.en: : The other three are fighting a mushroom.
lines.zh: : 另外三个人在打蘑菇。

lines.en: : Well, two mushrooms. You and I aren’t in combat and they’re the first monsters of the game, so it’s pretty safe to say they’ll die before we even get there.
lines.zh: : 嗯，是两只蘑菇。你和我不在战斗里，而且它们是游戏里第一批怪，所以基本可以肯定，在我们赶到之前它们就死了。

lines.en: : Oh. Well umm, want to trade character sheets and look at each other's stuff in the meantime then?
lines.zh: : 哦。那，嗯……要不要趁现在交换角色卡，看看对方的属性什么的？

lines.en: : I already read yours but you can read mine.
lines.zh: : 我已经看过你的了，不过你可以看我的。

lines.en: : When did you even do that?
lines.zh: : 你什么时候看的？

lines.en: : Do you want my sheet or not?
lines.zh: : 你到底要不要我的卡？

lines.en: : Oh...uhh...yeah. Sure.
lines.zh: : 哦……呃……要。当然。

lines.en: scene beachdnd16
: Okay, what did you guys roll?
lines.zh: : 好，你们掷了多少？
: 十九。
: 十六。

lines.en: : Rin?
lines.zh: : Rin？

lines.en: : Okay. Well, we’ll start combat with Ayane then.
lines.zh: : 好。那我们先从Ayane开始战斗。

lines.en: scene beachdnd49
: Do I get my sneak attack bonus for this?
lines.zh: : 这个能算偷袭加成吗？

lines.en: : Why would you get a sneak attack bonus? Both monsters are looking right at you.
lines.zh: : 你凭什么有偷袭加成？两只怪都正盯着你呢。

lines.en: : Because I’m a rogue and-
lines.zh: : 因为我是游荡者啊，而且——

lines.en: : Overruled.
lines.zh: : 驳回。

lines.en: : Ugh, fine. Then I guess I’ll just attack whichever one is closest to me with my daggers.
lines.zh: : 啧，好吧。那我就用匕首攻击离我最近的那只。

lines.en: scene beachdnd38
scene beachdnd49
: Does a 9 hit?...
lines.zh: : 九点命中吗？……

lines.en: : It does.
lines.zh: : 命中。

lines.en: scene beachdnd38
: Okay, cool. Then that’s...
lines.zh: : 好，不错。那就是……

lines.en: scene beachdnd49
: That's 7 points of damage.
lines.zh: : 那是七点伤害。

lines.en: : And as a bonus action, I’ll use my two-weapon fighting and attack the same monster again.
lines.zh: : 然后用附赠动作，我用双武器战斗再攻击同一只怪一次。

lines.en: scene beachdnd38
scene beachdnd49
: Does a 9 hit?
lines.zh: : 九点命中吗？

lines.en: : Yes. Nothing has changed in the last five seconds, so a 9 still hits.
lines.zh: : 命中。过去这五秒什么都没变，所以九点还是命中。

lines.en: : Awesome. Then that’s another...
lines.zh: : 太好了。那就是再来……

lines.en: scene beachdnd38
: That's another 4 points of damage.
lines.zh: : 再来四点伤害。

lines.en: scene beachdnd40
: Okay! Mushroom numero uno is looking a little worse for wear, but still hanging on.
lines.zh: : 好！一号蘑菇看起来已经不太行了，但还撑着。

lines.en: : That means it’s Zagull’s turn.
lines.zh: : 那就轮到扎古尔了。

lines.en: scene beachdnd49
: Ha! As expected from a rogue. Two attacks and not a single kill. How sickening.
lines.zh: : 哈！不愧是游荡者。两次攻击一个都没杀死。真够丢人的。

lines.en: : Allow me to show you how a true warrior fights!
lines.zh: : 让本大爷来教教你们，真正的战士是怎么战斗的！

lines.en: scene beachdnd50
Sana cocks her hand back and rolls her die with a level of aggression I’ve never seen out of her before.
lines.zh: Sana把手往后一扬，以一种我从没在她身上见过的狠劲掷出了骰子。

lines.en: That aggression is succeeded, however, by a moment of cuteness that I can not comprehend but entirely appreciate.
lines.zh: 不过这股狠劲之后紧跟着一瞬间的可爱，我无法理解，却完全欣赏。

lines.en: scene beachdnd51
: Ah! Natural-20!
lines.zh: : 啊！天然二十！

lines.en: : Ayyy! Zagull Throat Spear already making himself known as the MVP.
lines.zh: : 耶！扎古尔·贯喉之矛一上来就坐实了 MVP 的位置。

lines.en: : I did it!
lines.zh: : 我做到了！

lines.en: : You did! I’m still going to need to know what your damage rolls add up to, though.
lines.zh: : 你做到了！不过我还需要知道你的伤害骰加起来是多少。

lines.en: scene beachdnd52
: Oh! I’m so sorry. Umm...let’s see...
lines.zh: : 哦！抱歉抱歉。嗯……让我想想……

lines.en: scene beachdnd50
: That’s umm...20 damage total.
lines.zh: : 那是嗯……总共二十点伤害。

lines.en: scene beachdnd40
: Mushroom numero dos has been vanquished! Which leaves us with the grand total of one mushroom, who gets to attack before Nithhala.
lines.zh: : 二号蘑菇已被消灭！所以我们总共还剩一只蘑菇，而且它能在尼萨拉之前行动。

lines.en: : Of course it does.
lines.zh: : 当然了。

lines.en: : After watching his dear mushroom comrade fall at the hands of Zagull, the remaining weakened mushroom turns to look at the orc barbarian.
lines.zh: : 在目睹亲爱的蘑菇同胞倒在扎古尔手下之后，剩下的那只虚弱蘑菇转头看向兽人蛮战士。

lines.en: : A single tear rolls down his cheek.
lines.zh: : 一滴眼泪顺着它的脸颊滚落。

lines.en: : Mushrooms can cry?...
lines.zh: : 蘑菇会哭？……

lines.en: : No. But they also can’t hop out of trees or turn around either.
lines.zh: : 不会。可它们本来也不会从树上跳下来或者转身啊。

lines.en: scene beachdnd53
: Silence! I told you it will make sense later!
lines.zh: : 肃静！我说了以后会说得通的！

lines.en: : Sorry. I’ll shut up.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我闭嘴。

lines.en: scene beachdnd40
: As I was saying, a single tear rolls down the mushroom’s cheek and it begins to glow a more vibrant shade of purple.
lines.zh: : 我接着说，一滴泪顺着蘑菇的脸颊滚落，它开始散发出更鲜艳的紫色光芒。

lines.en: : You can tell that the scent is beginning to grow more pungent, as if it’s desperately crying out for help.
lines.zh: : 你们能感觉到那股气味变得更刺鼻了，仿佛它在拼命呼救。

lines.en: : Or maybe even trying to protect itself and avenge its friend.
lines.zh: : 或者甚至是在试图自保，为同伴报仇。

lines.en: : Why is she making us feel bad for the mushroom?
lines.zh: : 她为什么要让我们同情一只蘑菇啊？

lines.en: : Because-
lines.zh: : 因为——

lines.en: scene beachdnd53
: I said silence!
lines.zh: : 我说了肃静！

lines.en: scene beachdnd40
: The violet fungus takes one look at Zagull, which may very much be its last and uses “Rotting touch.”
lines.zh: : 紫蕈看了扎古尔一眼——这很可能是它最后的一眼——然后使出了「腐烂之触」。

lines.en: scene beachdnd54
: Does a...13 hit?
lines.zh: : 十三点……命中吗？

lines.en: : No. My AC is a little higher than that.
lines.zh: : 没中。我的护甲等级比这高一点。

lines.en: : Wow. All that drama for nothing then.
lines.zh: : 哇。闹了半天全白搭。

lines.en: : I guess this brings us to Nithhala's redemption turn.
lines.zh: : 那么我想，轮到尼萨拉的救赎回合了。

lines.en: scene beachdnd55
: Excellent. You said the first mushroom was looking a little worse-for-wear, right?
lines.zh: : 太好了。你说第一只蘑菇已经不太行了，对吧？

lines.en: : Correct. It’s also crying now as well.
lines.zh: : 没错。它现在也在哭了。

lines.en: scene beachdnd56
: Heh...Perfect. Then this is really the only roll that matters at the end of the day.
lines.zh: : 呵……完美。那么到头来，真正重要的只有这一掷。

lines.en: : Nithhala lifts her finger and points at the remaining monster. Her eyes narrow as she focuses everything she has on eliminating it.
lines.zh: : 尼萨拉抬起手指，指向剩下的那只怪。她眯起眼睛，把全副心神都集中在消灭它上。

lines.en: : Then, after taking a deep breath, her eyes widen and she casts Eldritch Blast.
lines.zh: : 然后，她深吸一口气，睁开眼睛，施放了魔能爆。

lines.en: scene beachdnd57
: Oh, you’ve gotta be kidding me.
lines.zh: : 哦，你他妈在逗我吧。

lines.en: : A 6 doesn’t hit does it?
lines.zh: : 六点不中吧？

lines.en: : Actually, it does.
lines.zh: : 其实，中了。

lines.en: scene beachdnd58
: Really?! Then-
: BUT-
lines.zh: : 但是——

lines.en: : ...But what?
lines.zh: : ……但是什么？

lines.en: : Isn’t the attack modifier for Eldritch Blast a plus five? That would mean you rolled a natural-1.
lines.zh: : 魔能爆的攻击加值难道不是正五吗？那也就是说你掷出了天然一。

lines.en: scene beachdnd59
: Don’t do this to me.
lines.zh: : 别这样对我。

lines.en: : Your Eldritch Blast misses the mushroom and connects with a tree ten feet to the side of it.
lines.zh: : 你的魔能爆没打中蘑菇，击中了它旁边十英尺外的一棵树。

lines.en: scene beachdnd60
: This is still a victory in my book...
lines.zh: : 在我心里这仍然是场胜利……

lines.en: scene black
The battle ends on the next turn as Ayane’s character manages to slice the mushroom monster in half.
lines.zh: 战斗在下一回合结束——Ayane的角色成功把蘑菇怪劈成了两半。

lines.en: Shortly after that, the party reconciles and comes to the conclusion that all of them have been summoned here from different worlds.
lines.zh: 之后不久，小队和解，得出结论：她们都是从不同的世界被召唤到这里来的。

lines.en: Not knowing what else to do or where else to go, they decide to band together.
lines.zh: 别无他法、也无处可去，她们决定结伴同行。

lines.en: But it’s around that time that I decide to leave.
lines.zh: 不过就在这个时候，我决定离场了。

lines.en: It’s clear that this sort of thing just...isn’t for me.
lines.zh: 显然这种东西……不适合我。

lines.en: But then again, it doesn’t seem like many things are.
lines.zh: 但话说回来，适合我的东西似乎本来也不多。

lines.en: I’ll just focus on getting a good night’s sleep and wake up tomorrow feeling refreshed and ready to go.
lines.zh: 我还是专心睡个好觉，明天精神饱满地醒来吧。

lines.en: scene nightsky
I think it’s pretty safe to say that this was a mostly-successful first day of vacation.
lines.zh: 我想，说这是度假的第一天，大体上是成功的，应该没问题。

lines.en: Sure, there were a few parts of it that went a little different than I expected-
lines.zh: 当然，有那么几处跟我预想的不太一样——

lines.en: But overall, it was a great experience.
lines.zh: 不过总的来说，这是一次很棒的经历。

lines.en: And I’m hoping that tomorrow, something even greater happens.
lines.zh: 而且我希望明天能发生更棒的事。

lines.en: $ beachvacation8 = True
$ ami_love += 1
$ maya_love += 1
$ ayane_love += 1
$ sana_love += 1
$ rin_love += 1
$ molly_love += 1
$ tsuneyo_love += 1
Your affection with Ami, Maya, Ayane, Sana, Rin, Molly, and Tsuneyo has increased by 1 point each!
lines.zh: 你与Ami、Maya、Ayane、Sana、Rin、Molly、Tsuneyo的好感度各提升了 1 点！
